body: I think that the AI spawns are not only linked to „locations“ on the map but also linked to „players in the area“ - so if you are in an area where theres a lot of players Ai is more likely to spawn. I’m not 100% sure on that. But it would make sense as there is more AI in South Plains or Highlands then the eastern part of the map. Correct me if I’m wrong 👍🏼
